title: Edmund and the Orbit
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Ansel Pemberton, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
